name: Cleghorn Fire Road (2N47)
description: Ridge run with incredible views. The main road is 2WD friendly; offshoots require 4x4. Perfect introduction to mountain wheeling with panoramic vistas of the Cajon Pass.

name: Lytle Creek / Stockton Flats
description: Perfect for a quick run. Light water crossings and shaded campsites along the creek. Great for families and beginner groups looking to practice water crossing techniques.

name: Holcomb Creek
description: Iconic rock crawling trail. The Gatekeeper sets the tone - if you can't clear it, turn back. Holcomb Creek crossing and deep ruts make this a must-do for experienced wheelers.

name: Gold Mountain (3N69)
description: Starts easy, ends challenging. The rock garden at the summit tests both driver and rig. Nylon strap recommended - this trail is notorious for body damage. Unmatched summit views of Baldwin Lake.

name: Dishpan Springs
rigRequirements: Heavy Mods / 37-inch Tires / Lockers / Armor / Winch
description: The big leagues. Deep bowls, off-camber climbs, and shelf roads that'll test the best-built rigs. Named for the bathtub-size springs. Bring recovery gear and expect body damage.

name: Mojave Road (West/Central)
description: Historic desert crossing from Colorado River to Barstow. Sand, lava tubes, volcanic formations, and the iconic Mojave mailbox. Bring extra fuel and water.

name: Ocotillo Wells SVRA
description: California's largest OHV area. Sand dunes, badlands, mud caves, and slot canyons. Blowsand Hill tests your climbing skills.

name: Berdoo Canyon
rigRequirements: High Clearance / Skid Plates / Extra Fuel
description: Sand and small rocks through canyon. Extra credit obstacles at the end. Any 4x4 can handle the main trail.

name: Coxey Road (10S01)
description: Easy fire road perfect for beginners. Winding through pine forests with multiple spur roads for dispersed camping. Great for testing new rigs.

name: Dumont Dunes
rigRequirements: 4WD / Wide Tires / Flag Required / Air Down
description: The tallest dunes in California. Competition Hill separates the brave from the willing. Wide-open sand playground with extreme terrain.

name: Thimble Trail
description: Narrow shelf road winding through pine forest. Steep drop-offs and tight turns require precision.

name: John Bull Trail
rigRequirements: Heavily Modified / 35-inch Tires / Lockers / Winch / Armor
description: The Gatekeeper stops most stock rigs. Deep ruts, massive ledges, and tight squeezes. Legendary for eating body panels.

name: Odessa-Doran Loop
description: Popular loop connecting historic Holcomb Valley sites. Mix of fire road and technical rock sections.

name: Outer Limits
rigRequirements: Rock Buggy / Trophy Truck / Experience Essential
description: Part of the King of the Hammers course. Extreme rock crawling and high-speed desert sections.

name: Jack North Trail
description: Rolling desert trail with scenic views of Johnson Valley and surrounding ranges.

name: Big Johnson
description: Named with humor, this trail delivers serious challenges. Steep rock ledges and tight squeezes.

name: Idyllwild Mountain Road
description: Scenic mountain road from Hemet to Idyllwild. Paved then graded dirt through pine forests.

name: Truckhaven Trail
description: Historic route through badlands near the Salton Sea. Winding climbs and descents.

name: Jawbone to Lake Isabella
description: Epic desert traverse from Jawbone Canyon to Lake Isabella. Rolling hills and dry washes.

name: Burns Canyon
description: Technical desert trail connecting Pioneertown to Burns Canyon. Rock gardens and sandy washes.

name: Holcomb Valley (3N16)
description: Historic wagon road through Holcomb Valley's gold rush country. Passes historic mining sites.

name: Pilot Rock Truck Trail
description: Classic ridge run with commanding views of Cajon Pass and the I-15 corridor.

name: Knickerbocker - FS 2N08
description: Scenic forest route following Knickerbocker Creek. Great for families and beginners looking for easy mountain wheeling with beautiful views.

name: Mill Creek - FS 2N10
description: Classic Big Bear connector trail. Links many popular off-road adventures through beautiful pine forest.

name: Radford Truck Trail - FS 2N06
description: Winding fire road in San Bernardino National Forest. Closed seasonally - check USFS alerts before going.

name: Camp Osito - FS 2N17
description: Part of Skyline Drive trail system. Panoramic views above Big Bear Lake. Easy to moderate.

name: Polique Canyon - 2N09
description: Wide pine-forested route with mild elevation changes. Smooth dirt with occasional puddles after rain.

name: Blue Quartz 2N71
description: Beautiful dirt road with tree coverage. Dispersed camping spots with great views.

name: Van Dusen Canyon - 3N09
description: Gate locked Nov 1 - May 1. Starts near Highway 38, transitions from pavement to dirt.

name: Radford Frontline Road - FS 104
description: Casual meandering trail alongside shallow canyon. 8000ft San Bernardino Mountain views.

name: Sand Canyon - FS 2N27
description: Hard-packed sand and rocky gravel. Easy summer ride. No winter maintenance.

name: Gold Fever - 3N05
description: Scenic loop through Holcomb Valley with Gold Rush history stops. Mild terrain.

name: Coxey Road - FS 3N14
description: Long connector from Fawnskin to Lucerne Valley. Forest Service road with dispersed camping.

name: Hepburn Mine - 3N32
description: Scenic trail in Holcomb Valley. Diverse terrain and views. Access from south or north.

name: Clark's Grade - FS 1N54
description: Trail data imported from ONX Offroad. Visit ONX for full details.

name: Snow Slide - FS2N13
description: Recently reopened after years of closure. Scenic corner of Big Bear with challenging obstacles.

name: Upper Holcomb Creek Road - 3N08
description: Great for new off-roaders. Dense forest scenery with easy-to-moderate challenges.

name: 1N09 City Creek Trail
description: Long overland trail with shooting areas, yellow post campsites, and creek crossings.

name: Green Valley Bypass - FS 2N54
description: Short scenic connector between Holcomb Valley Road and Snow Slide Road.

name: Otay Mountain Truck Trail
description: Epic mountain climb with sweeping views over San Ysidro Mountains and San Diego in the distance. All dirt road.

name: Orosco Ridge Truck Trail 12S02
description: Winds through Cleveland Forest from Pamo Road. Very rutted - not well maintained.

name: Santa Ysabel Truck Trail
description: Narrow shelf road in Cleveland NF following Santa Ysabel Creek. Beautiful mountain views.

name: 11S04 Black Mountain
description: Limited-use trail in Cleveland NF Palomar District. Street-legal vehicles only.

name: 11S03 Lusardi Truck Trail
description: Ascends Carney Canyon between Black Butte and Senció Peak. Great views.

name: Cedar Creek Loop
description: Beautiful backcountry loop near three different waterfalls. Mix of graded dirt roads with some technical sections.

name: Tecate Peak
description: Mellow 2-track road to Tecate Peak. Grave road lower section. Ruts after rain.

name: Nate Harrison Grade
description: Dirt road into Palomar Mountain State Park. From scrubland to lush forests. Some rocky areas - high clearance recommended.

name: Corral Canyon Road
description: Main east-west connector in Corral Canyon OHV area. Poorly maintained forest service road.

name: Palomar Divide (9S07)
description: Trail data imported from ONX Offroad. Visit ONX for full details.

name: 8S05 North Palomar Mountain Road
description: Well-maintained but expect large rocks, ruts, steep drop-offs. Weather dependent.

name: 15S18 Sheephead Mountain Road
description: 4.6 mile out-and-back to top. Full 6.8 mile if going to terminus. Great views.

name: Las Alturas
description: Begins off Mexico 2 near El Hongo. Fork right after toll road. Varied terrain.

name: 16S08 Fred Canyon Road
description: Usually run with Fred Canyon to create loop. Forest service road.

name: Grapevine Canyon Trail
description: Hard-packed dirt through private property - be respectful. Rocky to smooth dirt.

name: 15S05 La Posta Truck Trail
description: Usually run with Fred Canyon. 7.6 mile point-to-point in Cleveland NF.

name: Blair Valley Loop
description: In Anza-Borrego Desert State Park. Two small valleys with attractions to see.

name: McCain Valley Road
description: Scenic high desert drive with two overlooks of Carrizo Canyon. Great lunch spot at Corrizo Overlook.

name: Mine Wash
description: 9.6 mile out-and-back in Anza-Borrego. Stay the Trail area. Street-legal only.

name: El Compadre
description: Well-maintained dirt road stretching from El Hongo to Oso Negro. Gateway to numerous ranches.

name: Rouse Ridge via Cottonwood
description: Scales Rouse Ridge/Thomas Mountain with stunning 360 views. Great combination trail.

name: San Jacinto Ridge Trail FS 5S09
description: Two-way trail between Banning-Idyllwild Highway and Bee Canyon. Mostly hard-pack dirt with stunning mountain views.

name: Black Mountain
description: Well-maintained fire road to Boulder Basin. Turnouts for rock climbing along the way.

name: 6S13 Thomas Mountain Road
description: Uneven, rutted dirt trail with loose rocks and sand. Muddy in rain season. Steep sections.

name: Santa Rosa Truck Trail 7S02
description: Trail data imported from ONX Offroad. Visit ONX for full details.

name: Rouse Hill Road
description: Street-legal only - no green stickers. Full-size friendly with plenty of room.

name: Eureka Peak
description: 360-degree views from the top. Multiple hiking trails throughout. Best at sunset.

name: Rockhouse Canyon Road
description: 19.8-mile out-and-back in Anza Borrego. Starts at Clark Dry Lake. Street-legal vehicles only.

name: Coyote Canyon Road
description: Part of the famous wildflowers tour in Anza Borrego. Highway legal only. Smooth dirt surface.

name: Geology Tour Road
description: Family-friendly loop inside Joshua Tree National Park. Scenic with volcanic lava rocks and interesting rock formations.

name: New Dixie Mine Road BLM C2330
description: 8.5 mile road from Hwy 247. Generally an easy drive. Valley and wilderness views.

name: Integratron
description: Great intro to desert driving. Wide enough for two cars, framed by Joshua Trees.

name: Roadrunner Rut BLM S1421
description: Easy dirt road climbing into boulder gardens. Changes name crossing BLM lands.

name: Giant Rock
description: Cross Means Lakebed to reach Giant Rock. Smooth desert sand with small washes. Lots of trail choices.

name: BLM C3524
description: Mellow sandy road climbing into boulders. Rated 2 only because of a couple obstacles.

name: Bighorn Connector
description: Well-used connecting BLM roads near wilderness boundary. Easy sandy combo.

name: BLM C3429
description: Sandy road climbing from Cholla Road into boulders along wilderness boundary.

name: Sand Dune Expedition
description: Expansive desert playground. Northern Johnson Valley known for extreme rock-crawling Hammers.

name: Soggy Dry Lake to Cougar Buttes
description: Fun family ride. All dirt two-track with some sand and rocks.

name: Romp Route
description: Central entry point to network of trails. Commonly used - expect to share with campers.
